svg.title: Visual abstract: Mapping reactive glia to amyloid in Alzheimer's
svg.desc: Cell2location maps 12 glial state signatures onto 45,055 SEA-AD MERFISH spots from the human middle temporal gyrus. Inflammation-high spots (top 25 percent of reactive glia abundance) sit slightly closer to amyloid (Mann-Whitney p = 9.8e-5, rank-biserial 0.023), while the tissue-wide Spearman correlation is negligible (rho = -0.013).
